<image>
Transcribe this page, one line of text per written line.

[handwritten]
That her husband the aforesaid Ebenezer Woodard died on the 24th March 1832 and that she has  remained a widow ever since that period, as will near fully appear by reference to the proof hereto annexed. 
[signed] Milton Woodard “X” her mark
Sworn to and Subscribed
on the day and year above written 
before me and I certify that the said 
Elizabeth Woodard is unable to write
her name and made her mark for her
signature and is also unable to appear
before a Court of Record on account
of old age and bodily infirmity,
being most of the time confined to her bed.
[signed] L. F. Bower Judge of
Niagara County Courts
